start.text: Room? Full, full. But one boy is vacating Sunday. Rent ₹6,000 with food — cheapest in the lane. Pay token, I'll hold the bed for you.

choices.text: Can I see the room first?

no_see.text: Room is locked, boy is sleeping — night shift. Token first, then see. Everybody does like this only.

token.text: Thousand rupees. Refundable. Fully refundable, I'm telling you.

paid.text: Super. Sunday evening, come with luggage, I'll call you. Now I have to go — wife is calling.

refused.text: Your wish. Bed will go by evening, don't cry later.

again.text: You again? Still full. Token first, then we talk.

token_again.text: Same thousand. Price doesn't change because you came twice.

bye.text: Okay, okay. Bed will go by evening.
